display.label: AWS ECR Repository
display.description: Provision Amazon Elastic Container Registry (ECR) repositories with image scanning, encryption, and lifecycle tag immutability

globals.label: AWS Region
globals.description: The AWS region where resources will be provisioned.

resource.key_description: Unique name for the ECR repository. Serves as map key.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core repository settings including name, tag immutability, and deletion behavior.

fields.label: Repository Name
fields.description: Unique name for the repository. Can include namespaces separated by slashes (e.g., project/app).

validation.pattern_error: Repository name must be 2-256 lowercase alphanumeric characters, dots, underscores, dashes, and forward slashes.

fields.label: Image Tag Mutability
fields.description: Tag mutability setting for the repository. IMMUTABLE prevents existing image tags from being overwritten.

fields.label: Force Delete on Destroy
fields.description: If enabled, allows Terraform to delete the repository even if it contains container images.

sections.label: Security & Encryption
sections.description: Vulnerability scanning and server-side encryption settings.

fields.label: Scan on Push
fields.description: Indicates whether images are automatically scanned for vulnerabilities when pushed to the repository.

fields.label: Encryption Type
fields.description: Server-side encryption type used for images stored in this repository.

fields.label: KMS Key ARN
fields.description: The ARN of the custom KMS key for encryption. Leave empty to use the default AWS managed key (aws/ecr).

sections.label: Tags
sections.description: Metadata tags to assign to the repository.

fields.label: Resource Tags
fields.description: Key-value pairs to apply to the repository.
